body:
Thanks for reporting! I've tested your MRP and can confirm the bug exists in 4.4 and `master`.

Interestingly, when you change the declaration to `@export var data: Dictionary = Dictionary()`, the behavior starts to differ: On 4.4, it starts behaving as expected, but on `master` it starts complaining that the dictionary is read-only (possibly changed by https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/78837 ?). I can only assume this is related.

Edit: After some digging I think it's GDScript-caused, from the `Dictionary` side everything looks fine, as far as I can see. cc @godotengine/gdscript

I get the same issue trying to modify a dictionary in a packed scene by loading and resaving it using an `EditorScript`.

The exported dictionary becomes read-only when declared as `@export var data_dict: Dictionary[StringName, String] = {}`. It only happens when running tools scripts in the editor.

It is caused by `GDScript::_update_exports()`, which only runs in tool mode.

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/e6aa06d3de372513bedb036d2adb1052a9b4b87f/modules/gdscript/gdscript.cpp#L564-L565

This code path leads to `GDScriptAnalyzer::make_dictionary_reduced_value()`, which makes the shared dictionary read-only too. The same happens for arrays.

This is an issue about a tool script modifying a non-tool resource. The way around it is to reassign it to a new value before modifying or making the resource a tool script too. This might be intentional, but it’s unexpected since other exported types can be modified normally; only dictionaries and arrays have this restriction.
